scenario.title: Architecture model and declared project structure
situations: A change adds a component or crosses an existing boundary.
A monorepo has several test roots, sites or deployment targets.
Doctor reports architecture drift or an uncertain impact blocks readiness.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
scenario.review: Older research may describe heavier onboarding. Apply minimum activation and optional-adoption boundaries first.
questions: Which project-structure facts are user-authored, inferred proposals or live observations?
Do external projects receive enough explanation to resolve uncertain impact and model-doc drift?

lessons.title: Discover the existing project map before changing it
lessons.when: During project survey or when a proposed change touches a component boundary or cross-cutting dependency.
lessons.need: Learn where components, permitted dependencies, entrypoints and project structure facts live; the agent reads the authoritative payload and declares impact.
lessons.surface: Architecture page/health/draft; project-structure get and patch; architecture rule home
lessons.gap: These commands/rules exist; initial adoption and maintenance discovery have not been traced. Review question: should JOURNEYS include architecture-impact and project-topology-change scenarios without requiring every new project to model everything?
